basis: CWL Context Assertion v1 CloudEvents HTTP structured-message admission
normative_requirement: A consumer MUST admit the referenced Context Assertion event profile only when the outer transport advertises the CloudEvents JSON structured media type, MUST reject generic JSON, unsupported charset, duplicate parameters, and injected header syntax, and MUST preserve the complete event identity, truth, bitemporal, and provenance semantics established by the referenced event profile.
